_comment: Source of truth for the unified system wallpaper used by SDDM (host flake aa_desk-usr_x86_surface-linux_nixos) + desktop + lock screen (home-manager flake ba_flakes_desktop). All three converge on the same image so login → desktop → lock screen present a coherent visual. Resolved at run time via /run/current-system/sw/share/wallpapers/<theme>/contents/images/<image> (KDE plasma-workspace-wallpapers is in environment.systemPackages so this path is stable across rebuilds). Replicated verbatim from aa_desk-usr_x86_surface-linux_nixos/src/modules/cloud-data-wallpaper.json because Nix pure-eval flakes cannot read paths outside their own source root.

wallpaper._comment: KDE wallpaper theme name + image filename inside <theme>/contents/images/. Available themes: ls /run/current-system/sw/share/wallpapers/.
wallpaper._mode_comment: mode=color renders a SOLID COLOUR via plasma-manager's workspace.wallpaperPlainColor and ignores theme/image entirely; mode=image uses theme/image as before. 2026-08-12: switched to color/black on request. plasma-workspace-wallpapers ships no solid-black theme (Grey is the closest), so the colour plugin is the only way to get true black without shipping an image derivation just to hold one RGB value. theme/image are deliberately KEPT populated so flipping mode back to image needs no other edit.

testers._comment: Each invariant verifies one consumer is using the configured wallpaper. Update alongside any change to wallpaper.theme/image.

checks.description: Configured wallpaper image is present in /run/current-system/sw/share/wallpapers
SDDM Astronaut theme.conf Background= references the configured wallpaper
User kscreenlockerrc Greeter Wallpaper image matches the configured wallpaper (run as the desktop user)

deployment._comment: After editing this JSON, both flakes need a rebuild for SDDM and home-manager to pick up the new value.
